_comment: Timing and design thresholds shared by `showtime check` (scripts/check.mjs, before the render), `showtime qa` (lib/st/qa, on the final file) and `showtime retime` (lib/st/cli_core.py). Change them here only, so check and qa agree. min_contrast: WCAG ratio every text needs (an error for text >= 1% of the frame height). tiny_text_frac: readable text below this fraction of the frame height is a tiny_text warning (UI mockups marked data-st-decor are exempt). freeze_noise_db: the picture counts as unchanged while the mean absolute difference from the start of a hold stays under this level (qa: ffmpeg freezedetect n=, check: the same mean on its 64x36 luma samples), so small typing or a 2 px playhead is still a hold in both. label_gap_em: SVG labels in one graphic (chart values and axes, map names) that touch, or sit side by side or stacked closer than this fraction of their font size, are labels_crowded in `showtime check`. launch_hold_s: the still-hold limit for launch, promo, release and trailer films (showtime.json "kind"): a settled result or a still hook is how premium launch films breathe (their longest still stretches measure 4.3-5.5 s).
